phase: calibration — supersession audit on real recorded revisions

corpus.source: merge tombstones (status: merged) — supersessions the graph already recorded

excluded.aliases: 88 present; these are 'aka' search synonyms (BRO-1423), not merged-away entities. Deriving supersessions from them would be prose inference.
excluded.contradicts: 30 keys present, 1 non-empty; none carries a recorded resolution naming a superseding record.

corpus.writes_to_live_graph: none — all runs against a pinned detached worktree

check_taxonomy.note: A decision procedure has no precision to calibrate; demanding a statistical measurement for one is ritual, not evidence. Only one check in the audit is a heuristic.
decidable: temporal_recorded_at — parses / not in the future
temporal_supersedes — is a list / entries are strings / entries are [[wikilink]] form / not a self-reference
temporal_supersedes — target resolves to an entity file
temporal_revision_link — present when supersedes is / non-blank / string / not an orphan
heuristic: temporal_supersedes / timeline inversion: the superseded target's recorded_at is newer than this record's
check_taxonomy.caveat: One of the decidable checks — 'supersedes target resolves' — is crisp to EVALUATE but admits argument about INTERPRETATION: a target may be unresolvable because the tombstone was later cleaned up, not because the provenance is broken. It is reported as a defect because an untraceable supersession defeats the purpose of recording one, but that is a policy choice rather than a fact, and it is the check most likely to need revisiting when the corpus is larger.

positive_control.what: one injected defect per class, on a REAL migrated page; asserts the SPECIFIC field

power_limit.meaning: 0/7 is consistent with a true FP rate up to ~43%. This corpus cannot support a hard gate for any HEURISTIC check.
power_limit.timeline_inversion_unexercised: timeline_inversion is NOT exercised by the real corpus: the check compares the superseded target's recorded_at, and merge tombstones do not carry one. Its probe above had to synthesise a stamp onto a tombstone. Calibrating it on real data would require the envelope on tombstones too — a design decision, not a measurement.

rationale: The 11 decidable checks meet a soundness bar (12/12 positive controls fire on the specific field; 0/7 false positives; 37 mutations killed) — but soundness is not a reason to gate NOW: only 5 of 943 pages can currently exhibit these fields, so a gate would have almost nothing to protect and no operational history behind it.
The 1 heuristic check (timeline inversion) is unmeasured on real data and cannot be measured on this corpus at all, because tombstones carry no recorded_at.
Everything stays warning-only and opt-in behind --temporal. Default lint is unchanged.
revisit_when: the envelope is present on a substantial share of the graph through ordinary merge/revise use (not a migration), giving the decidable checks something to protect;
tombstones carry recorded_at, which is what would make timeline inversion measurable on real data;
an independent reviewer has judged a set of real supersession findings.
